ANDROID FIREBASE APP DISTRIBUTION - QUICK SETUP GUIDE
=====================================================

STEP 1: Add GitHub Secrets
---------------------------
Go to: https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/YOUR_REPO/settings/secrets/actions

Add these 3 secrets:

1. FIREBASE_ANDROID_APP_ID
   Value: 1:381838704656:android:aaa0ddbf1692003ee88a95

2. GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON
   Value: [Copy entire content from .github/GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON.base64]

3. FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
   Value: [Copy entire content from .github/FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT.base64]


STEP 2: Create Tester Group in Firebase
----------------------------------------
1. Go to: https://console.firebase.google.com/project/poetry-world-eaf6c/appdistribution
2. Click "Testers & Groups" tab
3. Click "Add group"
4. Name: testers
5. Add tester email addresses
6. Click "Save"


STEP 3: Test the Workflow
--------------------------
Option A: Push to develop branch
   git add .
   git commit -m "Setup Firebase App Distribution"
   git push origin develop

Option B: Manual trigger
   1. Go to: https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/YOUR_REPO/actions
   2. Click "Firebase App Distribution"
   3. Click "Run workflow"
   4. Select branch and click "Run workflow"


IMPORTANT NOTES:
----------------
- The .base64 files are added to .gitignore for security
- Never commit the actual service account JSON file
- The Firebase service account file in root should be deleted after setup
- Keep the .base64 files locally for reference only
